extras.limits_verbatim: Per-file cap widely reported at 100 MB for free (raised per-account via the 文件升级 setting; medium confidence — the operator's own page only says the setting exists). Share links are public by design. Registration requires 手机号 + SMS code.
extras.egress_verbatim: Explicitly unmetered: no download traffic limit, no speed limit, no download-count limit, and shares download without login.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited total x 100 MB per object is the pure 'per-record unlimited' shape the brief asks about: 20 TiB = ~210k objects. Registration needs a mainland phone number, so chaining is bounded by SIM supply, not by quota.
extras.tooling_verbatim: No official API. Community wrappers exist (lanzou uploader scripts, `lanzou-api` style repos); the browser upload form is the only documented path.
extras.agent_focus: regional and non-English large-file hosts, especially very large single-file caps with no total-storage limit

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
